tasks.completion_summary: Added FallbackPortCheck case + handleFallbackPortCheck in proxy_events.go so the 30s fallback-port safety net is no longer dead code; visible telemetry via startupErrorStore.

[hook 1/3] Daemon-side HOOK verb: VerbHook + HookPayload in protocol/commands.go; HookSend client with 50ms deadline + ErrHookDaemonDown/ErrHookDeadline sentinels; hub_hook.go new file with hookRingBuffer (1024-capacity mutex ring, drop-oldest overflow, atomic counter, notify chan), HookEvent struct, enqueueHookFromBytes (pure decoder split for testability), hubHandleHook verb adapter, drainHooks drain goroutine; alert_hub.go extended with HookEventSink interface + Add/Remove/BroadcastHookEvent; daemon.go wires hookRing field + Start launches drainHooks; hub_run.go registers VerbHook. 13 hook tests cover ring buffer ordering+overflow+concurrency+zero-cap panic, enqueue success+empty+invalid JSON+missing event+nil ring, drainHooks fan-out+nil-guard, alertHub multi-sink broadcast+remove+nil no-op. Two full daemon-race suite passes before commit. Parent task l9H72BWuHjBg was split into 3 phased subtasks; phases 2 + 3 (RNcgAOkDIn95, chcpjsGNJUXf) still pending.

[hook 2/3] CLI dispatcher: new cmd/agnt/hook.go with `agnt hook <event>` cobra subcommand (ExactArgs(1) + --session-id/--project-path/--agent/--tag/--event-override flags), hookInvocation struct + runHookInternal testable core (exit 0 swallowed failures, exit 2 config errors), buildHookTags merging typed flags over --tag entries, writeHookDropLog append-safe via O_APPEND + XDG_CACHE_HOME resolution + newline normalization. cmd/agnt/hook_test.go (22 tests) covers argument validation, tag merge precedence + malformed/empty-key rejection + equals-in-value, daemon-down silent-exit-0-no-droplog, wedged-daemon exit-0-plus-one-droplog with <500ms budget, in-process CLI->daemon round trip via daemon.AlertHub().AddHookSink, empty stdin, event override, malformed JSON stdin routing to droplog, deterministic droplog timestamps, newline normalization, concurrent drop-log O_APPEND safety, mkdir parent dir, goroutine leak probe, latency smoke (50 iterations <50ms worst-case). cmd/agnt/hook_bench_test.go adds BenchmarkHookColdExit (200 iter in-proc: 268µs avg, 627µs max — daemon contribution well under 1ms target). cmd/agnt/notify.go gets TTY-gated deprecation warning via term.IsTerminal(os.Stderr.Fd()) + sendNotifyHook best-effort HookSend(ctx, "notification", ...) fire-and-forget so phase 3 has an event to fan out without breaking the existing ProxyToast path. go vet clean, gofmt clean, cmd/agnt test suite green under -race. Daemon package has two pre-existing flaky tests (TestRunAutostartAsync_ExplicitDependencyTimeout_StillHonored, TestHubIntegration_FallbackPortCheck_EventLoopCreatesProxy) that fail only under concurrent load with cmd/agnt package and pass in isolation or with -p 1; unrelated to hook code.

[hook 3/3] Drain goroutine fan-out: internal/proxy/logger.go adds LogTypeHook constant + HookLogEntry struct + Hook *HookLogEntry field on LogEntry (flat shape to avoid the daemon->proxy import cycle). internal/daemon/hub_hook.go drainHooks now delegates to new fanOutHookEvent helper that runs four consumers in cheapest-first order: (1) session heartbeat via SessionRegistry.Get + UpdateLastSeen when ev.SessionID is populated, (2) StreamSink publish via alertHub.BroadcastLogEntry(LogEntry{Type:hook}, '') so `agnt monitor --types hook` streams events live, (3) per-proxy broadcastNotificationToast iteration calling proxym.List and BroadcastToast when event == 'notification' (back-compat for `agnt notify`), (4) typed HookEventSink fan-out via BroadcastHookEvent. Per-event errors are swallowed to debug log; malformed JSON payloads short-circuit at decode so drain never wedges on garbage. 8 new drain fan-out tests in hub_hook_test.go cover synthetic LogEntry reaches StreamSink, session heartbeat bumps LastSeen + flips status active, unknown session is silent no-op, notification broadcasts toast on every registered proxy (real httptest backends via proxym.Create), non-notification does not trigger toast branch, malformed payload survives, missing message field skips toast, end-to-end drain goroutine delivers to all three consumers. cmd/agnt/monitor.go adds LogTypeHook cases to formatCompact (shows [hook:event] session_id|agent) and formatJSON (Message=event, Location=session_id|agent|project_path fallback), plus 'hook' in --types flag help; 7 new monitor_test.go tests cover both formatters + nil handling + provenance fallback chain. cmd/agnt/notify.go collapsed to a pure HookSend alias: runNotify validates --message, emits TTY-gated deprecation warning, then calls new dispatchNotifyHook core which swallows all errors (ErrHookDaemonDown, ErrHookDeadline, any other) and always returns exit 0. cmd/agnt/notify_test.go (new file, 3 tests) covers daemon-down returns 0, always-returns-0 contract, empty kind still exits 0. CLAUDE.md adds a ~90-line Hook Dispatcher section with the event->drain-behavior matrix, sample ~/.claude/settings.json hook block, cost contract (p99 <=5ms, measured ~270us), drain fan-out order doc, monitor streaming examples, and the `agnt notify` back-compat contract. examples/.agnt.kdl adds a commented canonical Claude Code hook registration block listing 9 common events (pre-tool-use, post-tool-use, notification, user-prompt-submit, session-start, session-end, stop, subagent-stop, pre-compact) as an operator reference. File count = 9 (above 5-cap, flagged by plan: 3 files are docs/examples, 1 is a single-constant edit to logger.go, 1 is a new test file; core logic lives in 3 files). go vet clean, gofmt clean, make test green, -race clean on cmd/agnt + internal/daemon + internal/proxy. No regressions in phase 1 or phase 2 tests.
